title: Normalized host-trial result
description: One scenario trial on one host in one arm, normalized before invariant evaluation and evidence sanitization. Nothing validates against this document at runtime; it is the checked-in contract the parity modules and release evidence agree on.

scenario_id.description: Identifier of the scenario this trial executed.

host_version.description: Exact host CLI version, recorded verbatim.

arm.description: Guided arm, or the paired control arm with the target description ablated.

trial.description: One-based trial number within the arm.

outcome.description: Trial outcome. UNAVAILABLE records a degraded dimension; INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE is retryable and is never a behavioral result.

observations.description: Observable facts extracted from the trial. Recognized keys are selected_skill, output, exit_status, extra, and state_files. state_files maps a project-relative path to that file's contents and is what state_file_contains invariants read; it is distinct from the sibling state_changes array below.

state_files.description: Project-relative path to file contents, captured after the trial.

state_changes.description: Files and project state the trial created, modified, or removed.

infrastructure_failure.description: Classified infrastructure cause, present only when the trial did not produce behavioral evidence.

reviewed_hook_hash.description: Hook hash an operator approved through /hooks for a trusted-hook trial.

plugin_versions.description: Installed plugin versions, keyed by plugin name.

prompt.description: Sanitized prompt actually sent to the host.
